rationale: Initializes the recurrent-tail gate tensors to tiny nonzero values so the shared reverse-tail path starts receiving useful recurrence gradients as soon as the zero-projection blocks begin moving, while keeping the initial network effectively unchanged. Carry gates get an even smaller seed to preserve the decoder-output anchor during the second tail revisit. Also fixes the masked chunk-loss accumulator for correctness if logit chunking is enabled.
title: Seeded Tail Recurrence Gates
